onboarding.welcomeDescription: Let's get your account ready in two steps, then we'll show you the dashboard. What's your name?
onboarding.nameSaveError: Your name could not be saved. Retry, or skip the tour and add it later from Settings.
onboarding.areaDescription: The active area defines which region you monitor: the map, indicators and alerts are scoped to it. You can change it anytime from the header.

map.title: Epicenter map
map.description: This is where the seismic events of your area of interest live in real time: each circle is an earthquake, sized and colored by magnitude. You can enable layers (tectonic plates, cities) from the Layers button.

globe.title: 3D Globe
globe.description: The same seismic activity, but on an interactive globe: ideal for seeing global activity at a glance and understanding patterns at planetary scale.

areas.title: Areas of interest
areas.description: Choose which region to monitor: Andes, Japan, Cascadia and more. The active area drives the whole dashboard — map, indicators, events table and alerts.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: The bell gathers the active alerts: significant events, swarms and felt activity in your area. The number shows how many there are right now.
